app.name: App Gallery
app.description: Server-generated application-intent review followed by approved template selection and provisioning.

routes.purpose: Verify the current session and application-provisioning permission through the configured Admin API.
Submit an idempotent application description and receive a server-generated decomposition for review.
List approved templates available to the current session through the configured Admin API.
Submit an idempotent server-side application provisioning request.
